title: Gibson Coated 80/20 Bronze Acoustic Guitar Strings, Ultra-Light Gauge

long_description.body:
Developed under the direction of Gibson’s Master Luthiers, Gibson 80/20 Bronze Acoustic Guitar Strings bring out the brilliance in your guitar’s natural acoustic voice. The strings are wrapped with an 80% copper, 20% zinc alloy, which delivers brighter, crisper tones than phosphor bronze strings while maintaining an acoustic tone that cuts through studio and live mixes and helps control overly powerful low end. They are a favorite in studio and full-band environments, as well as any style where immediate, brilliant sound is the goal.



The hex-shaped, high-strength tinned steel core provides strength and volume, while the 80/20 bronze wrap ensures bright, crisp tones
Lightly coated for reduced string noise and extended life while maintaining authentic acoustic sound
Developed and tested by Gibson Master Luthiers for all Gibson acoustic guitars
Made in the USA
Ultra-Light Gauge: .011, .015, .022w, .032, .042, .052
Light Gauge: .012, .016, .024w, .032, .042, .053
Medium Gauge: .013, .017, .026w, .035, .045, .056
